8.36. iLock_Geography.railyard_import¶

The module defines functions for obtaining railyard objects.

Currently it consists of one public function fromLayoutEditor that is used to import railyard from the layout editor.

Functions

fromLayoutEditor([unlock, mutable, tolerance]) Return either a railyard object or a MutableRailyard object from the layout editor.
orient_railyard(mutable_railyard[, …]) Orient a railyard
